name: Establish Sleeping Quarters
description: Bring six mattresses to the lumbermill manager to finish the crew's sleeping quarters.
reward_description: 30 Merch and proper sleeping quarters for the crew.

dialogue.describe: The crew needs somewhere decent to sleep.
dialogue.offer: We've made room for sleeping quarters, but we still need six mattresses.  Bring them here and I'll pay you 30 Merch.
dialogue.advice: Try taking apart ordinary beds in houses or motels.  You'll want a truck for the mattresses.
dialogue.accepted: I'll clear a spot to unload them.
dialogue.rejected: All right.  We'll make do for now.
dialogue.success: The crew finally has proper beds.  Here's your 30 Merch.
dialogue.failure: I guess we're sleeping where we can for a while longer.

name: Repair the Mill
description: Bring three drive belts, including makeshift replacements, to keep the lumbermill running reliably.

dialogue.offer: We can still cut lumber, but the drive belts are wearing out.  If they go, the saw stops.  Bring three drive belts, factory-made or makeshift, and I'll pay you 20 Merch.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find actual drive belts on engines, a good replacement can be made from a belt and some duct tape.  Nothing difficult.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.success: That'll keep the saw running reliably.  Here's your 20 Merch.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

//: Only retained for existing saves that already have this mission.
name: Get 1,000 Nails
description: Obtain 1,000 nails in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Along with those drive belts, we were waiting for some nails for structural repairs.  Due to <the_cataclysm>, we obviously never received them.  So, I need you to get us 1,000 nails.  We'll pay you fairly.
dialogue.advice: Taking apart some furniture in town should get what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.success: Our warehouse was about to fall apart.  These will be extremely helpful to us.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

name: Fortify the Lumberyard
description: Bring 5,000 nails to finish the lumbermill's perimeter walls.
reward_description: 90 Merch and new perimeter walls for the lumbermill.

dialogue.describe: We need 5,000 nails to finish the perimeter.
dialogue.offer: That chain-link fence won't hold forever.  We can cut the wood for a proper wall, and we have some fasteners, but we're still short 5,000 nails.  I'll pay you 90 Merch for the lot.
dialogue.advice: You might have to do more than just scrapping a bunch of furniture.  Dismantling a building somewhere in town could get you what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.success: That's the last of what we needed.  The yard's got a proper wall now.  Here's the 90 Merch I promised.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

name: Get 6,800 Nails
description: Bring 6,800 nails to finish the lumbermill's perimeter walls.

dialogue.describe: We need 6,800 nails to finish the perimeter.
dialogue.offer: We have the wood for a proper wall, but we're short 6,800 nails.  I'll pay you 90 Merch if you bring them in.
dialogue.advice: Dismantling a building somewhere in town could get you what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.success: That's the last of what we needed.  The yard's got a proper wall now.  Here's 90 Merch for the nails.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

//: Only retained for existing saves that already have this mission.
name: Find 6 Blankets
description: Obtain 6 blankets, fur blankets, electric blankets etc in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Now that we should be safe from harm, I decided to start adding a few things to this place.  Right now, we don't have anywhere to comfortably sleep, so we're building a small sleeping quarter.  We just need 6 big, warm blankets to finish our project.
dialogue.advice: I figure any hotel or motel in town should have lots of blankets, whatever types you can find for us.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find us some bedding yet?
dialogue.success: Thanks!  Feel free to sleep here if you want.  It's the least we can do for the help.
dialogue.success_lie: How is this supposed to help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

//: Retained so old saves can load this mission and turn in a writ they already obtained.
name: Establish A Trade Route
description: Establish trade relations between the loggers and a refugee center, and bring back a writ of the agreement.

dialogue.offer: While some of us were out scavenging, we spotted an old evac shelter that looks like it might have some people inside.  I want you to go over there, find whoever runs the joint, and see if we can make a deal with them for some processed lumber.  This will be invaluable to our survival.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Please give it a try?  This is really important to us.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about the deal?
dialogue.success: Thank you!  We're set for life on this one!
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.
